newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey bans trading by three intl. brokerages.
newsitem.headline: Turkey bans trading by three intl. brokerages.

text.p: Turkey's regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) banned SBC Warburg, Caspian Securities Limited and Kleinworth Benson Securities from trading on Turkish capital markets.

In its weekly bulletin, the SPK said the brokerages could not make any transaction directly or indirectly until they provided the identities of their clients on behalf of whom they made deals in Turkish Airlines shares earlier in the year.

The SPK has been conducting an inquiry into alleged manipulation of THY shares since August. It had sent letters to several foreign institutions in mid-August, asking them to disclose the names of their clients.

The board imposed a new disclosure rule on October 7, requiring all foreign brokers and banks to ask details of the identity of clients and report them to the SPK in order to be able to carry out foreign investors' buy or sell orders.
It said it began to enforce the rule because foreign intermediaries did not disclose the identities of their clients when asked to do so in the THY investigation.
